text:
Hk9 Educational Coloring Book Campaign
Inspiring kids. Empowering veterans. Supporting service dogs.
The Heartland Kids’ Coloring & Activity Book is more than a fun activity book — it’s a mission-driven project designed to teach children about service dogs, honor the Veterans who rely on them, and support Heartland Canines for Veterans in training life-saving dogs for those who served.
Every page features real Heartland service dogs, Veteran stories, and interactive activities that help kids understand courage, empathy, and what it truly means to “Never Walk Alone.”
The book is distributed at schools, libraries, veteran events, and community programs, giving families a positive and meaningful introduction to service dogs and the work they do.
Why This Campaign Matters
Veterans across our nation depend on highly trained service dogs to navigate PTSD, anxiety, mobility challenges, night terrors, and daily life. Each dog takes months of training and thousands of dollars to prepare — and Heartland provides them at no cost to the Veteran.
This coloring book helps make that possible and helps to educate the public.
Your Sponsorship Creates Real Impact
When a business sponsors this project, they’re not just placing their name in a book — they’re helping fund training, supplies, vet care, and placement for the next service dog team. Sponsors become part of a campaign that reaches thousands of families and directly supports the mission of helping Veterans reclaim independence, confidence, and peace.
Community Reach
Print run: Multiple Sponsor opportunities available.
Distributed across Missouri and surrounding states
Featured on a 30,000-follower book review account
Given out at schools, kids’ events, veteran organizations, and community partners
A Meaningful Way to Give Back
The Heartland Coloring & Activity Book gives businesses a chance to support Veterans in a way that is visible, family-friendly, and long-lasting. Every time a child opens the book, they see a positive message, a real service dog, and a reminder that strong communities stand behind their Veterans.

"One of Us" Campaign
The "One of Us" Campaign was designed to create more than an opportunity for organizations to give and Veterans to receive. We believe in life-long bonds and partnerships. This campaign gives organizations an opportunity to invest in the success of a specific Veteran and their K-9 partner, now, and for years to come.
What can you expect from participating in this campaign?
Your business, company, or organization chooses the name of the K-9. Want to name the dog after your organization? Awesome, the choice is yours! Have an internal race based on funds raised to "win" the naming of the K-9, draw it out of a hat... unfortunately, the Veterans come pre-named.
Your campaign covers all training for the K-9 and Veteran Team, routine veterinarian care, all the gear, equipment, kenneling and administrative costs for the K-9 Team
We do press releases on the partnership you create with us for the team, an amazing gift deserves amazing recognition!
You become part of the team's process. Training updates, videos, pictures, all of it.
And of course, graduation from our program! At your facility or ours, expect media coverage and another press release.
The Campaign doesn't end there. Visits, Christmas and birthday cards, it's all possible!
Contact us by clicking the button below to learn more about this program and join the Heartland Team!

"Paws" for Giving
"Paws" for Giving is designed to allow companies, businesses and individuals to provide wall space, counter space or window space for HK9 to put up our specially designed logo with a QR code to give employees or patrons an opportunity to donate to HK9.
Put it on your checkout counter, front display windows, break room wall, car window, anywhere you believe people will see it and help HK9 provide service dogs COST FREE to our Veterans.
The stickers we have on order are 4"x4" and will be available by 2023!
They will be no cost to your business, but gifts are ALWAYS accepted.
Request your Stickers Here
Dog House Donation Box
Our Dog House Donation Box Campaign is for companies and businesses to provide counter space for HK9's Donation Box for cash donations.
Put it on your checkout counter or anywhere you believe people will see it and help HK9 provide service dogs COST FREE to our Veterans.
The boxes are small and provide information to let people know where their gifts are going.
They will be no cost to your business, but gifts are ALWAYS accepted.
Request your Dog House Here
The Heartland Ambassador Campaign
Give your employees and patrons an opportunity to see a service dog in action!
Would you like to have us come to you? That is the idea with our Ambassador Campaign. Heartland would love the chance to come to your venue.
This campaign is perfect for organizations that would like to:
Promote a grand opening or other event for your business
Educate your employees on service dogs
Educate you patrons on service dogs
Ask questions about our different campaigns
Learn about ADA rules and laws
Support HK9 and spread the word about our programs and service dog capabilities
We'd love to have a team visit us!
